analogy.name: A tap vs a filled bucket
analogy.line: A list fills the whole bucket before you drink. A generator is a tap: you get the next glass only when you ask, so memory stays small.

analogy.name: A chess simultaneous exhibition
analogy.line: One master walks between many boards, makes a move, and moves on while each opponent thinks. One thread, many games, as long as nobody holds the master up.
